'''Gaff Kilvaari''' was the leader of an element of the [[Sullustan Resistance]] that planned to attack the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] generally looked down upon the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
